Latin word

effundō

effundō, effundere

verb, third conjugation

pour out; pour out or spill

In this lexicon

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 23.12.1: effundī … jussit ānulōs aureōs; Petr. 135.2: partem legūminis super mēnsam effūdit

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 383
